decisions.reason: After several years in the portfolio, the certified HVAC plate-exchanger line carries sunk development and certification costs and remains close enough to the core heat-exchange business that management would likely continue rather than reverse course.

The marine box cooler system showed visible market traction, fits the firm's established marine cooling capabilities, and is therefore the kind of publicly validated product management is least likely to withdraw.
This compact oil cooler line extends the existing thermal-management offer with multiple models, so accumulated investment and strategic fit make continued support more likely than abandonment.

The finned tube offering supports the broader air-cooler business and, despite limited later visibility, management would tend to keep it because it reinforces the firm's broad engineered portfolio and prior commitment.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes align with the firm's innovation-led engineering path, and the R&D effort and public presentation behind them favor persistence unless results become clearly untenable.
